items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I still love that number. Do you know every time I see Vic Dickerson, I ask him to play that for me.

ctx.x: Right. "Please Don't Talk About Me When I'm Gone."
I still love that number. Do you know every time I see Vic Dickerson, I ask him to play that for me. That's one of my favorite tunes, and I just love to hear Vic Dickerson play it with the plunger.
